operations.description: Deletes a group from the organization (but not from the account). The group must be in the organization. This call requires the role ROLE_ORG_WRITE.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete group [PATH] groups [PARAMS] authorization group key [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Deletes a user from the organization (but not from the account).
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete user [PATH] users [PARAMS] authorization key user [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Queries multiple group identities in the organization domain. Filtering, sorting and pagination are available. This call requires the role ROLE_ORG_READ.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] groups [PATH] groups [PARAMS] authorization filter [SCHEMA] collection group member metadata

operations.description: Queries group details in the organization domain. This call requires the role ROLE_ORG_READ.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] group [PATH] groups [PARAMS] authorization group key [SCHEMA] group member metadata

operations.description: Queries the user schema. The user schema is defined in SCIM Core Schema (http://www.simplecloud.info/specs/draft-scim-core-schema-01.html#resource-schema).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] user schema [PATH] schemas users [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] attribute resource schema sub

operations.description: Queries service provider configurations. The service provider configurations are defined in SCIM Core Schema (http://www.simplecloud.info/specs/draft-scim-core-schema-01.html#anchor6). This call returns a description, a documentationURL, name, and specURL.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] service provider configs [PATH] service provider configs [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] authentication bulk change configs data etag filter format password patch provider schemes service sort xml

operations.description: Queries multiple user identities in the organization domain. Filtering is available.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] users [PATH] users [PARAMS] authorization filter [SCHEMA] collection full metadata name user

operations.description: Queries the identity of the current authenticated user.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] me [PATH] users me [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] full metadata name user

operations.description: Queries user identity in the organization domain.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] user [PATH] users [PARAMS] authorization key user [SCHEMA] full metadata name user

operations.description: Updates one or more values of an existing group without sending the full definition. Member groups and member users must be in the organization. This call requires the role ROLE_ORG_WRITE.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] update group [PATH] groups [PARAMS] authorization group key [SCHEMA] definition group member metadata

operations.description: Changes a limited set (or all if you choose) of the current authenticated user's data. The updated user email domain must be an existing organization email domain.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] update me [PATH] users me [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] definition full metadata name user

operations.description: Changes a limited set (or all if you choose) of the user's data. The updated user email domain must be an existing organization email domain.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] update user [PATH] users [PARAMS] authorization key user [SCHEMA] definition full metadata name user

operations.description: Creates a new organization group and adds it to the user domain. Member groups and member users must be in the organization. This call requires the role ROLE_ORG_WRITE.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create group [PATH] groups [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] definition group member metadata

operations.description: Creates a new organization user and adds them to the user domain. The user email domain must match an existing organization email domain.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create users [PATH] users [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] definition full metadata name user

operations.description: Updates an existing group. The request must include the full group definition. To modify one or more values without sending the full definition, see "Update Group". Member groups and member users must be in the organization. This call requires the role ROLE_ORG_WRITE.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] replace group [PATH] groups [PARAMS] authorization group key [SCHEMA] definition group member metadata

operations.description: Changes the current authenticated user's displayName, locale, timezone, username and password. The request must include the full user definition (to modify one or more values without sending the full definition, see Update User). The replaced user email domain must be an existing organization email domain.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] replace me [PATH] users me [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] definition full metadata name user

operations.description: Changes an existing user's displayName, locale, timezone, username and password. The request must include the full user definition (to modify one or more values without sending the full definition, see Update User). The replaced user email domain must be an existing organization email domain.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] replace user [PATH] users [PARAMS] authorization key user [SCHEMA] definition full metadata name user
